Co25Fe25Mn15Ni25Ti5Al5 (at.%) HEA ingots with dimensions of Φ 80.0 mm × 140.0 mm were prepared via vacuum induction melting using high-purity (> 99.9 %) Co, Fe, Mn, Ni, Ti, and Al.
During smelting, argon gas (0.5 bar) was introduced to maintain an inert atmosphere. The elements were sequentially added in the order of Ni/Fe/Co → Ti → Al → Mn.

evidence.section: 2.2. Optimization of the homogenization annealing process
evidence.quote: Samples were annealed at 900 ◦C, 1000 ◦C, and 1100 ◦C for 2 h and 4 h, respectively, designated as 900–2, 1000–2, 1100–2, 900–4, 1000–4, and 1100–4. After annealing, all samples were cooled in the furnace.

evidence.section: 2.2. Optimization of the homogenization annealing process
evidence.quote: Homogenization treatments were conducted in an argon atmosphere using a gas-tight tube furnace. The chamber was purged with argon for 30 min before heating to eliminate residual oxygen.
